title: Marcos, Dy join Angara in Isabela school visit for feeding program

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III joined Education Secretary Sonny Angara in a visit to Patul Elementary School in Santiago City, Isabela, on Friday to highlight programs supporting children’s nutrition, safety, and well-being. The visit featured DepEd’s Home-Grown School Feeding program, which provides nutritious hot meals
